name: danmaku
description: Bilibili-style bullet comments that fly across a few lanes above the prompt as Claude works: heckles about what it does, philosophers' lines that fit the moment, or philosophers heckling it, in Chinese, English or both

style.title: Comment style
style.description: heckle: Bilibili-style heckles about what Claude does. philosophy: a line from a philosopher that fits the moment, with who said it and their school. philosopher-heckle: philosophers of many schools heckling what Claude does, each from their own point of view

language.title: Language
language.description: chinese, english, or bilingual: each comment in Chinese with the English after it

model.title: Comment model
model.description: The model that writes the comments

density.title: Density
density.description: How often the model is asked for comments: low every 8s at most, normal 4s, high 2s

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: How many rows the comments fly in above the prompt
